subject.title: fix: use explicit agent workspace when writing transcript headers

question: Should maintainers adopt this stale conflicting branch, ask the contributor to rework it, or replace it with a current-main fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49523?
rationale: The bug is real and security/session-sensitive, but the branch is no longer cleanly mergeable and the remaining fix shape crosses message delivery and session metadata boundaries.

options.title: Replace with current-main repair
options.body: Use the issue as canonical and land a fresh or heavily rebased patch that resolves cwd from caller config plus session owner context without a fresh config reload.

options.title: Ask contributor to rework and prove
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if the contributor rebases it, fixes the mirror/config hazards, and adds real behavior proof from a realistic setup.

options.title: Close this PR and keep the issue
options.body: If maintainers do not want to adopt the branch, close the PR while leaving the canonical issue open for a cleaner implementation.

recommendation.title: Replace with current-main repair
recommendation.body: Use the issue as canonical and land a fresh or heavily rebased patch that resolves cwd from caller config plus session owner context without a fresh config reload.
